These queries are untested and written from the doc page alone. A few forms are guesses: `round 1` and `round 2` for the digit count, `groupBy ~(/key)` taking a key quote, `indexBy` keeping the element under each key, and `parseJson` turning a numeric string into a number. N4, N5 and N10 are worked around from verbs on the page: `union` for the merge, a filtered map in place of `vals`, and `split " " | join ""` for trimming.

N1: /data/users | filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :email | type | eq ::string) | * (/email | split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort
N2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * {:c /customer/name :s (/lines * (mul /qty /unit_price) | sum) :d (at :discount | coalesce 0)} | * {:c /c :a (sub /s /d)} | :rs / | * /c | distinct | * (:n / | {:customer n :total (rs | filter ~(/c | eq n) * /a | sum | round 2)}) | sort ~/total | reverse | take 2
N3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | coalesce {:login "unassigned"} | /login) | groupBy | * count
N4: :a (at :dependencies | coalesce {}) | :b (at :devDependencies | coalesce {}) | a | union b | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys | sort
N5: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | :en / | {:enabledCount (en | count) :ports (en * (at :port) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | distinct | sort) :totalReplicas (en * (at :replicas | coalesce 1) | sum)}
N6: lines | filter ~(contains " ERROR ") | * (split "[" | /1 | split "]" | /0) | :sv / | distinct | * (:n / | {:service n :count (sv | filter ~(eq n) | count)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /service]) | take 2
N7: lines | drop 1 | * split "," | filter ~(count | eq 4) | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | filter ~(/3 | ne "") | * {:r (/0 | lower) :v (mul (/2 | parseJson) (/3 | parseJson))} | groupBy ~(/r) | * (* /v | sum | round 2)
N8: :ev / | :li (ev | filter ~(/type | lower | eq "login") * /user) | :lo (ev | filter ~(/type | lower | eq "logout") * /user) | li | distinct | filter ~(:u / | lo | contains u | not) | sort
N9: filter ~(at :salary | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~(/dept) | * (* /salary | {:s sum :n count} | div /s /n | round 1)
N10: lines | filter ~(ne "") | * (split ":" | /1 | split ",") | flat | * (split " " | join "" | lower) | distinct | sort
N11: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","apple","date"] | * lower | :ws / | distinct | * (:n / | {:word n :count (ws | filter ~(eq n) | count)}) | filter ~(/count | gt 1) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word])
N12: /releases | filter ~(/draft | eq false) | filter ~(/prerelease | eq false) | * {:tag /tag_name :downloads (/assets * (/download_count | coalesce 0) | sum)} | sort ~/downloads | reverse | take 3
N13: filter ~(/category | lower | eq "tools") | :t / | {:count (t | count) :allPriced (t | every ~(at :price | coalesce 0 | gt 0)) :inStockNames (t | filter ~(/stock | gt 0) * /name | sort)}
N14: lines | * (split "#" | first | split " " | join "") | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "-" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | * {:n (split "==" | first | lower) :v (split "==" | /1)} | indexBy ~/n | * /v
